summary: Enhance your knowledge on Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA) with our comprehensive training. Learn sustainable farming practices and adapt to a changing climate.
lede: Climate-smart agriculture helps farm professionals assess climate risks and choose practices suited to farming conditions. The course is for extension officers, agronomists, project staff and other field practitioners who need to turn farm assessments into action plans. It builds skills in vulnerability screening, selecting soil and water management or crop and livestock adaptation options, and tracking implementation with monitoring tools.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who need to connect climate information, farm practice, and field delivery in a practical CSA setting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of agriculture, extension, rural development, or project implementation; basic familiarity with farm systems; no coding required. You should be ready to review simple field data, climate information, and farm-level case studies. Advanced technical concepts such as climate-risk screening and CSA monitoring are taught at operational level, while digital tools such as weather apps, farm decision aids, and simple mapping workflows are introduced for practical use rather than technical configuration.
